title: Zesty Spring Canadian Asparagus Gratin
description: A fresh and creamy Canadian dish featuring spring asparagus, perfect for a special occasion. This low-fat friendly recipe is steamed to perfection in individual mini cocottes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Trim the asparagus spears to fit the individual mini cocottes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the light cream, grated cheddar cheese, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the lemon zest and chopped fresh parsley to the bowl and stir to combine.
Place 3 asparagus spears in each mini cocotte and pour the cream mixture over the asparagus.
Cover the mini cocottes with foil and steam in the oven for 12 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 5 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
